Author: NahayaSakafuku
Name: FFMMD
Description: 在游戏内直接导入 VMD 并播放 GPose 角色动作，无需 Blender。支持内置裙骨物理：导入后后台解算并复用缓存；本地音乐同步播放、中英文 UI、快捷键与原生声音屏蔽。支持多人舞蹈（实验性，尚未完全验证）。/ Import VMD motions in GPose without Blender, with built-in skirt physics preprocessing and reusable caches, music, bilingual UI, hotkeys and game audio muting. Multi-character dancing is experimental and not fully validated.
Punchline: 游戏内 VMD 动作、裙骨物理与音乐；实验性多人舞蹈
